title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Purchase Experience team is seeking a full stack software development engineer with a passion for engineering excellence. We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility & high-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi-tiered, low-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both funcational and non-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhacing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and develop full-stack solutions for Cart/Checkout services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi-tiered distributed systems
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
* Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data-driven analysis and experimentation
* Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

A day in the life
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long-term health.
  
  
**About The Team**
We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
**About The Team**
Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) Technology delivers scalable fulfillment solutions for third-party sellers, integrating transportation, inventory, warehouse operations, billing, and delivery. The team bridges Marketplace and Walmart’s supply chain, collaborating with Product, Business, Operations, Supply Chain, and Transportation partners. Combining the agility of a growth business with the scale of a global retailer, the team drives innovation and expands fulfillment capabilities into new models and international markets. This environment emphasizes technical excellence and cross-functional collaboration to develop impactful solutions that enhance the seller fulfillment experience.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
Distinguished Engineer is one of the most coveted technical IC titles at Walmart - and this role lives up to it. As a Distinguished Engineer on the WFS team within Growth Tech, you will be developing services that helps millions of sellers to leverage Walmart Fulfilment Services. You will write code, design systems, review architectures, and solve the problems that are complex. Your world-class expertise in distributed systems, API design, and platform engineering will be paired with a Al-forward mindset.
  
  
This is a high-impact role sitting at the intersection of scale, commerce, and platform engineering. You will own the technical vision and execution for a portfolio of mission-critical, cross-cutting services that enables Seller through Seller Center UI and APIs. You will be the technical standard-setter across all of it.
  
  
What You'll Own Technically
  
  
The Walmart Fulfilment Services team is essential to the Marketplace ecosystem, responsible for designing and scaling the global platform that supports the complete seller fulfilment within Walmart marketplace journey. The team develops robust global workflows, and complex multi-platform integrations connecting cloud microservices, seller portals, and AI-driven analytics. You will own Architecture, design, development and delivery of Seller journey, addressing distributed systems challenges, optimize APIs, and establish architectural standards to enable international marketplace growth.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Architecture & System Design
  
  

* Lead end-to-end technical design for complex initiatives involving from API contracts, UI interfaces and data models to distributed system topologies and cross-cutting concerns.
* Drive platform standardization by defining and documenting reference architectures, design patterns, and implementation guardrails that teams adopt
* Evaluate and select technologies, frameworks, and cloud-native patterns with a clear-eyed understanding of trade-offs at Walmart's operational scale
* Author and review RFCs and architecture decision records (ADRs) that become the technical canon for the platform

Hands-On Engineering
  
  

* Write production-grade code and not prototypes or proof-of-concepts, test and deploy them to production
* Solve complex problems considering performance, reliability and scalability
* Prototype new solutions rapidly using Al-augmented development workflows and then drive them to production quality
* Conduct deep-dive code reviews that raise the technical bar of the team.
* Own the full software development lifecycle for your initiatives involving design, development, testing, deployment, observability

Complex Problem Solving
  
  

* Solve the hardest and complex problems and enable the team while doing so
* Lead technical investigations for P0/P1 incidents affecting platform services; own the root cause analysis and define permanent fixes
* Challenge technical assumptions early in the design process before they become expensive production mistakes
* Navigate ambiguity with confidence by breaking down underspecified problems into structured technical approaches and drive alignment across stakeholders

Platform Reliability & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Design for resilience from first principles. Define and own the platform's non-functional requirements
* Instrument systems to be deeply observable and use the signals to drive continuous improvement
* Build runbooks and operational playbooks that enable the broader team to operate the services confidently

Al & Innovation
  
  

* This role is Al-forward by design and needs someone who actively shapes how it is used and pushes the frontier of what Al-augmented engineering looks like at scale.

Day-to-Day Al Fluency
  
  

* Proficient with GitHub Copilot, Wibey, and LLM-based tooling as active, daily parts of your development workflow
* Use Al to compress every phase of the engineering loop: schema design validation, code generation and review, test coverage acceleration, documentation, drafting, incident root-cause analysis, and API design feedback
* Identify where Al can replace toil, then build the automation yourself

Al-Native Platform Thinking
  
  

* Architect and build Al-native capabilities like intelligent API health monitoring, Al-assisted seller onboarding flows, smart alerting and anomaly detection
* Evaluate and integrate Al/ML capabilities into services where they create measurable seller value
* Stay current on the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and bring high-signal, opinionated recommendations to the team

Al Advocacy & Enablement
  
  

* Model Al-augmented engineering practices for the team through live demos, pairing sessions, and written guides
* Work with engineering leadership to identify and prioritize investments where Al creates the most leverage across teams
* Contribute to the broader Walmart engineering community's understanding of how to build and operate Al-augmented systems responsibly

What You’ll Bring
  
  
Distinguished Engineers at Walmart lead through technical gravity. Your impact multiplies across teams.
  
  

* Raise the floor - your code reviews, design feedback, and written standards lift the quality of every engineer in the team
* When a team is stuck on a systems design challenge or a production crisis, you are the person who helps unblock
* Your architectural decisions today shape the technical capabilities and codebase for the future
* Grow technical depth across the org through tech talks, design reviews, RFCs, and hands-on pairing, you are a force multiplier for technical growth across Growth Tech
* Bridge platform and product translate complex technical constraints into clear trade-offs that inform product decisions; translate product ambitions into technically sound, phased engineering strategies
* Pioneer Al adoption - model what Al-augmented engineering looks like at the Distinguished level and create the patterns, playbooks, and tooling that the broader team follows

**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Work
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

**own the warpSpeed platform backend**
and lead a small team of two to three backend developers. You’ll report to the CTO, but day to day you’ll run the backend side of engineering yourself: turning product requirements into APIs and services, making architecture and data-model decisions, reviewing code and keeping production healthy.

The backend is the heart of the product. It connects to users’ Google and Microsoft accounts, keeps their email, calendars and contacts in sync, serves the mobile and web apps over REST and WebSockets, runs background jobs and scheduled automations, handles subscriptions and billing, and feeds data to our AI service. It’s a real system with real users, not a greenfield prototype, so we need someone who can improve it steadily while it keeps running.

This is a hands-on lead role. You’ll still spend most of your time designing and writing code, but you’ll also be the person the team goes to with questions, and the person the CTO relies on to know the state of the platform and keep delivery on track without close supervision.

**﻿What you’ll do:**

**Lead the backend team**

* Take product requirements and turn them into a technical design, API contracts and well-scoped work for the team.
* Set and uphold coding standards, review pull requests and give feedback that improves the team.
* Mentor and unblock the other backend developers and help them grow.
* Own delivery: estimate honestly, flag risks early and keep the CTO informed without needing to be chased.

**Own the platform**

* Design and build REST APIs and real-time (WebSocket) features for the mobile and web apps.
* Build and maintain integrations with third-party providers: Gmail, Microsoft Graph / Outlook, IMAP, CalDAV and others, including OAuth flows, rate limits, webhooks and the edge cases that come with them.
* Own the sync engine that keeps users’ email, calendar and contacts up to date, making it more reliable, efficient and observable.
* Design database schemas and migrations, and keep queries fast as data grows.
* Build event-driven and scheduled background work using queues and distributed cron jobs.
* Own production health: monitoring, alerting, incident response, root-cause analysis and follow-up fixes.
* Keep security and privacy at the centre: we hold access to people’s inboxes, and we treat that with the care it deserves.

**Work across the product**

* Work closely with the AI engineers on the contract between the backend and our Python AI service: what data the assistant can see, which actions it can take and how token usage is accounted for.
* Work with the mobile team on API design, pagination, real-time events and error handling that makes sense on a phone.
* Work with the CTO on infrastructure and deployment on AWS.
* Write and maintain the technical documentation the team relies on.

**What you’ll bring**

* **6+ years of professional backend development, including 3+ years building production services in Node.js and TypeScript.**
* Experience leading or mentoring other developers, whether as a tech lead, a team lead or the senior engineer others rely on.
* Strong API design skills (REST, and ideally WebSockets / Socket.IO), with a clear sense of what makes an API good to use from a mobile client.
* Strong relational database skills: schema design, migrations, indexing and query tuning, ideally MySQL or PostgreSQL with an ORM such as Prisma.
* Experience with asynchronous and distributed systems: message queues, background workers, retries, idempotency and job locking.
* Experience integrating with third-party APIs at scale, including OAuth 2.0. Direct experience with the Gmail API or Microsoft Graph is a big plus.
* Hands-on experience running services on AWS (or another major cloud) in containers, with CI/CD pipelines.
* Good instincts for security: authentication, authorisation, secrets management and handling sensitive personal data.
* Experience with automated testing (unit and integration) and a habit of leaving code better tested than you found it.
* The ability to work independently in a fully remote team: you take ownership, communicate clearly in writing and don’t wait to be told what to do next.
* A degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

**Our backend stack**

You don’t need to have used every one of these, but it helps to know what you’ll be working with:

* Node.js and TypeScript in a pnpm monorepo of shared packages and independently deployable services
* Koa for the REST API, with Zod for validation and Swagger for API docs
* MySQL with Prisma
* Redis / Valkey, AWS SQS and a standalone scheduler service for background and scheduled work
* Socket.IO for real-time updates to clients
* Gmail API, Microsoft Graph, IMAP and CalDAV integrations
* Stripe, App Store and Google Play billing
* AWS: ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, OpenSearch and CDK for infrastructure as code
* A change-data-capture pipeline (Debezium) that feeds our vector search indexes
* GitHub Actions, Jest, Bugsnag and Amplitude
* A Python / FastAPI / LangGraph AI service that the backend calls for the AI assistant

**Nice to have**

* Experience building email, calendar or messaging products, or deep knowledge of email standards (MIME, threading, IMAP).
* Experience with subscription billing across Stripe and the mobile app stores.
* Experience with infrastructure as code (AWS CDK, Terraform or CloudFormation).
* Experience with search and vector databases (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch) or change-data-capture pipelines.
* Experience integrating LLMs into backend systems, or enough Python to work comfortably with our AI service.
* Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar), and good judgement about when to trust them.

**What we offer**

* A highly competitive salary.
* Fully remote work.
* Real ownership: you’ll lead the platform backend, not just a ticket queue.
* An engineering-led, collaborative environment with a founder who values technical excellence.
* A product in daily use by a growing global user base, at the cutting edge of applied AI.

* Own production quality: tracing, observability, error handling and incident follow-up for the AI service.

**Work across the product**

* Work closely with the backend team on the contract between our Node.js platform and the AI service: what data the assistant sees, which actions it can take and how results come back.
* Work with product and design to define what the assistant should do, and be honest about what current models can and can’t do reliably.
* Keep up with a fast-moving field and bring in new models, techniques and tools when they earn their place.

**What you'll Bring:**

* **6+ years of professional software engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-powered applications that real users depend on.**
* Strong Python: async programming, type hints, packaging and testing (pytest). You write production code, not just notebooks.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain and LangGraph, or equivalent agent frameworks, building tool-calling and multi-agent systems.
* Solid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) experience: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies and retrieval quality tuning.
* Experience designing and running LLM evaluations (datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing), and the discipline to trust measurements over intuition.
* Strong prompt engineering skills, with an understanding of how prompts, tools and context interact across different models.
* Experience building and operating API services (ideally FastAPI) on a cloud platform, with observability and CI/CD.
* An understanding of LLM security and privacy risks, including prompt injection and data leakage.
* Experience leading or mentoring other engineers, whether as a tech lead, a team lead or the senior engineer others rely on.
* The ability to work independently in a fully remote team: you take ownership, communicate clearly in writing and don’t wait to be told what to do next.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Our AI Stack**

You don’t need to have used every one of these, but it helps to know what you’ll be working with:

* Python with FastAPI and uv
* LangChain and LangGraph, with a supervisor agent and a dozen domain sub-agents
* Google Gemini (via Vertex AI) as the primary model, with OpenAI embeddings
* AWS OpenSearch for vector search across per-domain indexes
* LangSmith for tracing and evaluation
* Valkey (Redis) for agent checkpointing, and MCP adapters for tool integration
* A background enrichment worker that processes new user data as it arrives
* pytest, Black, pre-commit, Bugsnag and GitHub Actions
* AWS ECS Fargate, deployed with AWS CDK
* A Node.js / TypeScript backend that the AI service is called from and calls back into

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with Gemini or Vertex AI, and working across more than one model provider.
* Experience with LangSmith (or Langfuse, Braintrust or similar) for tracing and evaluations.
* Experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, including hybrid lexical and vector search.
* Experience building AI features over email, calendar or other personal productivity data.
* Experience with agent memory, long-running agents or scheduled automations.
* Enough TypeScript / Node.js to work comfortably in our backend.
* Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar), and good judgement about when to trust them.

**What we offer:﻿**

* A highly competitive salary.
* Fully remote work.
* Real ownership: you’ll lead the AI assistant at the core of our product.
* An engineering-led, collaborative environment with a founder who values technical excellence.
* A product in daily use by a growing global user base, at the cutting edge of applied AI.
